messages.subject: interpreting probability of detection with habitat use
parts:
Hi I am running some occupancy analysis on cam trap data.
Cam trap are not independant for the species (=one individual can be trapped in several cameras). I have habitat description as covariates for each trapping station (canopy height, nb of trees, ..)
My concern was mainly habitat preferences. I have habitat description as covariates for each trapping station (canopy height, nb of trees, ..)
Unsurpringly, Psi is 1 in all models with habitat covariates on psi, the species is everywhere on the sampled area.

However, some habitat covariates have an influence on Detection probability, p.
easy to interpret if related to understory density, but sometimes with no obvious relation with the detection itself: for example : canopy_height.

Can I interpret this as the probability of presence of the species in sites in relation this Covariates ? so relating it to avoided or prefered habitat characteristics  ?

discussion with colleagues ...
thanks !
